title: Advogado Sênior (EUDR)
description:
Você conhece a Bunge?

Distribuída em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 117 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos. Valorizamos a diversidade de nossos times e buscamos talentos criativos com espírito de equipe e vontade de fazer a diferença. Em tudo o que fazemos, colocamos em prática nossos valores:

  • Atuar como um só time, promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  • Buscar a excelência, sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  • Fazer o que é certo, agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

Missão do Cargo

Como advogado(a) nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na condução de assuntos relacionados ao EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento) e outras questões socioambientais. Você fornecerá suporte jurídico especializado e estratégico para garantir a conformidade com o EUDR, com foco na devida diligência em relação à origem dos produtos, à verificação do cumprimento da legislação aplicável nos países produtores (incluindo direitos humanos, direitos dos povos indígenas e comunidades locais) e à mitigação de riscos. Seu background generalista em áreas como Direito Tributário, Trabalhista e Compliance será um diferencial para uma atuação integrada e completa.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

Consultoria Jurídica:

  • Consultoria jurídica especializada para a área de direitos humanos e sustentabilidade em conformidade com o EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento), bem como nas demais áreas de legalidade exigidos pelo EUDR, como trabalhista, tributário, compliance, entre outras, baseada nos procedimentos e políticas internas da companhia.
  • Elaboração de pareceres e memorandos jurídicos com a avaliação de risco, com base na documentação analisada para evidenciar a devida diligência por parte da empresa.

Contencioso:

  • Análise de processos administrativos e judiciais,considerando os aspectos relacionados à conformidade com a EUDR.
  • Análise de documentos processuais, incluindo processo de licenciamento, licenças ambientais, estudos de impacto ambiental, autorizações de supressão vegetal, TAC, plano de manejo, etc.,verificando sua conformidade com os requisitos do EUDR.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o fluxo dos processos desenvolvidos por advogados externos,garantindo a conformidade com a estratégia da empresa em relação ao EUDR.

Compliance:

  • Realização de controles internos utilizando o sistema jurídico interno.
  • Acompanhamento legislativo e reporte à gerência e diretoria jurídica sobre os impactos das alterações legislativas no negócio, com foco em legislação socioambiental,incluindo atualizações e análises sobre o EUDR e outras regulamentações internacionais relevantes.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, considerando os riscos legais, reputacionais e financeiros associados ao descumprimento do EUDR.
  • Elaboração de relatórios dedue diligenceem direitos humanos e sustentabilidade,com foco na diligência devida e os requisitos de rastreabilidade e transparência da cadeia de suprimentos do EUDR.

Outras atividades:

  • Participação em grupos de trabalho, internos e externos, interagindo com diferentesstakeholders,com foco em EUDR e outras questões socioambientais relevantes.
  • Prover treinamentos às áreas de interface.

Impacto/Dimensão

O(A) Advogado(a) desta posição desempenha um papel estratégico na mitigação de riscos e na geração de valor para a empresa, contribuindo diretamente para:

  • Redução de passivos ambientais e sociais: Através da análise criteriosa de documentos e da emissão de pareceres jurídicos, o(a) profissional contribui para a prevenção de multas e processos judiciais, gerando uma economia à empresa.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com a legislação e as melhores práticas: A atuação do(a) advogado(a) garante que os projetos e as operações da empresa estejam em conformidade com as leis e normas socioambientais, evitando sanções e danos reputacionais. Isso envolve a análise de diversos documentos por ano e a emissão de pareceres que subsidiam decisões estratégicas à área de originação, sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.
  • Promoção da sustentabilidade e dos direitos humanos: O(A) profissional atua ativamente na implementação de políticas e práticas de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos, contribuindo para o alcance dos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável. Isso inclui a participação em diversos projetos por ano, com alcance nacional e internacional, e a interação com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Fortalecimento da reputação da empresa: A atuação jurídica ética e responsável na área de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos contribui para o fortalecimento da imagem da empresa perante seus stakeholders, gerando valor para a marca e atraindo investimentos.

APM Terminals, a global leader in port and terminal operations and part of the A.P. Moller-Maersk Group, is committed to delivering world-class container handling, logistics solutions, and maritime services. The DBA will collaborate closely with terminal and regional infrastructure teams to uphold current standards, implement robust backup and recovery policies, and carry out database tuning and performance monitoring to support business continuity and system optimization.

  • Develop processes for optimizing database security.
  • Set and maintain database standards.
  • Manage database access.
  • Performance tuning of database systems.
  • Install, upgrade, and manage database applications.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot database errors.
  • Triage reported issues to accurately identify, escalate, and respond to urgent or critical matters in support of terminal operations.
  • Identify root causes of outages and issues and prepare plans for permanent changes to eliminate/reduce chronic issues or establish SOPs for resolution by ‘shift left’ resources
  • Recommend and implement emerging database technologies.

About The Job
Being an Analyst at Google is about much more than simply crunching numbers – it’s about finding compelling insights within data and using your exceptional business and communication skills to translate those insights into action. As one of the masterminds behind our strategic planning, forecasting and analysis, you’ll spend your time digging into big, complex data sets. The data will not remain inert in your hands, however, since you’ll use your critical thinking, problem solving and communication skills to influence and drive thoughtful and well-informed decision making with our most senior business leaders within the organization, and potentially some of our biggest clients.
As a Data Integration and Measurement Lead within the Product team, your primary role will be to drive data maturity and establish robust measurement strategies across Spanish-speaking Latin American markets and their key clients. This involves providing deep expertise in data integration, and comprehensive measurement approaches, all while ensuring the adoption of Google's products. You will offer expert guidance on data integration and privacy solutions, empowering sales teams and clients to maximize their campaign effectiveness and overall business outcomes. You will analyze data-driven insights to optimize performance, educate stakeholders on privacy-first measurement techniques, and facilitate the seamless integration of data and measurement best practices across various teams and platforms. You will also serve as a central point of contact for data integration expertise, ensuring strategic alignment, driving measurable growth, and exceeding performance targets across the digital landscape. Furthermore, you will act as a crucial liaison between global product teams and regional sales/client support teams.
Global Solutions is the link between Google products and business. Your focus is to help turn innovation into complete, packaged tools that allow our customers to get the most that they need from our products. As part of the Global Solutions team, you'll help to ensure that Google has adopted the right strategy for our products. Working in one of three specialized areas – Performance, Brand, or Publisher & Platform – you'll use your expertise to help front-line Sales partners to work their magic quickly and effectively. You are passionate about all things digital, and want to help shape the world of online advertising.
Responsibilities
  • Act as the key liaison with global teams to communicate the needs and bring product launches and recommendations to sales teams, taking 100% ownership of assigned products.
  • Work and collaborate with numerous cross-functional teams to set the strategy for your products to achieve desired adoption.

  • Engage in specific client conversations when necessary, understand their business objectives and how the solutions can address their challenges.
  • Increase the advertiser's Digital AI maturity and overall media investment through the strategic usage of Data and Measurement technology.

title: Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho Sênior
description:
A General Mills está comprometida em ser uma força do bem por meio de uma estratégia global de inclusão para levar diversidade às nossas pessoas e cultura, possibilitando maiores níveis de envolvimento com nossos colaboradores para crescermos junto com nossos clientes e consumidores.
Para nós, criar um ambiente inclusivo e fomentar a diversidade impulsiona o crescimento da companhia, além de dar suporte para o crescimento de nossos colaboradores.

Sobre a Posição : Impactar vidas, promover uma cultura preventiva com foco em garantir a segurança dos nossos colaboradores, através da definição e divulgação de padrões e processos, promovendo a melhoria contínua de nossos sistemas de gestão de Saúde Ocupacional, Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente (HSE) e atendimento aos requerimentos legais, políticas e certificações da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

· Desenvolver, executar e apoiar a gestão de atividades de maior complexidade técnica com relação à Saúde Ocupacional, Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente

Apoiar no atendimento aos requisitos legais e corporativos, sistematizando os processos vigentes em todas as unidades/atividades de sua atribuição
Consolidar KPI's de SST e elaborar relatórios para a Coordenação e Gerência da área
Acompanhar perícias
Gerenciar riscos e minimizar impactos relacionados às atividades
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e novas tecnologias, além de multiplicar boas práticas
Elaborar estratégias administrativas e técnicas para suporte a gestão de HSE e protagonizar o Plano Estratégico da área com vista as execuções satisfatórias
Atender as diversas fábricas do complexo industrial, incluindo áreas de apoio, laboratório e manutenção em processos de campo (análise de segurança da tarefa, avaliação de risco, abertura de permissão para trabalho, investigação de incidentes)
Organizar e divulgar as regras de segurança corporativas
· Realizar treinamentos com as equipes (operacionais e administrativas)

Participar de reuniões de planejamento, realizar inspeções de campo nas áreas da empresa, verificar as condições de trabalho e de segurança, efetuar análises de riscos e ocorrências de HSE, orientar quanto a adequada utilização dos recursos de saúde e segurança do trabalho, sugerir e apoiar na implementação de medidas preventivas e/ou corretivas, visando resguardar a integridade física dos colaboradores, a prevenção de acidentes de trabalhos e fortalecer a cultura de saúde e segurança do trabalho

· Desejável conhecimento em SAP

· Desejável conhecimento em sistema SOC, PPP, Avaliações Ambientais

· Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Pouso Alegre – MG
· Disponibilidade para atuar no 2º turno.


Descrição da Empresa

A General Mills é uma empresa líder global em alimentos e trabalha para fazer os alimentos que o mundo ama! Nossas marcas globais incluem Cheerios, Annie's, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Häagen-Dazs, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Old El Paso, Wanchai Ferry, Yoki, Blue e muitas outras. Com sede em Minneapolis, Minnesota, EUA, a companhia chegou ao Brasil em 1997, quando iniciou as vendas do sorvete premium Häagen-Dazs. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. Somos hoje um time apaixonado de 35 mil colaboradores em mais de 100 países e em todos os continentes.

Diferenciais

  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.

Qualifications & Experience:
  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.
  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.
  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.
  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

About The Role
We are looking for a proactive and skilled DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience to join our growing engineering team. You'll be working closely with a small team of four engineers to build, maintain, and scale our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and observability stack. We value collaboration, strong communication, and a growth mindset: you'll be expected to contribute ideas, give and receive feedback, and work independently when needed.

Position Summary:

The IT Compliance & Application Security Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating IT compliance initiatives, with a strong focus on Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and cybersecurity requirements. This role ensures that IT controls are effectively designed, documented, and executed in alignment with regulatory standards and audit expectations.
This position plays a critical role in identifying risks, implementing cybersecurity best practices, and maintaining a robust control environment across both financial and non-financial systems.

Key Responsibilities:

Control Framework Ownership Develop and maintain application-specific control matrices (e.g., SoD, secure development, identity lifecycle, privileged access). Ensure alignment with frameworks such as COSO, COBIT, and NIST.

Policy Implementation & Oversight Translate enterprise security policies into actionable control requirements. Ensure consistent implementation across centralized (e.g., SAP GRC) and decentralized platforms.

Partner with internal software development teams to promote secure coding practices and integrate security checkpoints within CI/CD pipelines.

IAM & SoD Governance Develop governance over identity provisioning, role design, and segregation of duties enforcement. Coordinate exceptions and remediation plans in collaboration with IAM and audit teams.

Metrics & Reporting Define and report on KPIs/KRIs related to control effectiveness and risk posture. Deliver dashboards and reports to senior leadership and risk committees.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with application owners, cybersecurity architects, GRC analysts, and vendors to ensure compliance coverage.

Policies, Procedures, and Documentation Develop and maintain IT compliance policies and procedures. Ensure documentation meets audit standards and reflects current operations.

Education, and training, develop and train application and system owners on their responsibilities and self-assessment for security controls.

IT Controls & Frameworks Deep knowledge of ITGCs, application controls, and frameworks (COSO, COBIT, NIST). Experience in change management, access management, and system operations.

Audit Methodologies & Standards Familiarity with PCAOB, ISACA, and other audit standards. Experience working with internal/external auditors (Big Four experience is a plus).

Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge Strong understanding of SOX (especially Section 404), GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS.

GRC Tools Proficiency in SAP GRC and other GRC platforms for control monitoring and reporting.

Cybersecurity Fundamentals Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, incident response, and vulnerability management.

Data Analysis & Reporting Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and audit findings. Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools for reporting.

Interpersonal Skills:

Collaboration & Teamwork: Effective cross-functional collaboration.

Communication: Clear articulation of technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Leadership & Influence: Ability to drive compliance initiatives and gain organizational buy-in.

Adaptability: Flexibility in navigating regulatory and technological changes.

Strategic Thinking: Alignment of compliance efforts with business objectives.

Proactive Mindset: Anticipation of risks and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

  • Engage in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of design tools, product improvements, and standards for turbomachinery products, potentially assisting with interviewing and onboarding new team members.

What You Bring
  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent with 5+ years of experience in rotating machinery, or an Associate Degree in drafting with 10+ years of design drafting and industry experience. Those with more experience may be eligible for a more senior level.
  • Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail, ability to see the broader picture, and outstanding communication skills for effective collaboration across the organization.
  • Exhibits the capacity to independently manage complex projects while maintaining enthusiasm and intensity whether working individually or as part of a team.
  • Shows professionalism and tact in interactions at all levels, from management to clients, coupled with strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, advanced 2D/3D CAD, and familiar with ERP systems like SAP or Oracle, reflecting solid digital literacy.
  • Flexible and ready for domestic and international travel on short notice, anticipating about 5-15% travel requirement.

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical
The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.
A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.
Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

We offer

  • A master or PhD in pigs nutrition, animal Science, veterinary science, or a related field is preferred

We help the world run better

Your future role

Relentless focus on achieving the best for our customers.

Requisitos:

Competências Comportamentais:
  • Liderança e gestão de equipes
  • Visão estratégica e foco em resultados

  • Resiliência e adaptabilidade em ambientes dinâmicos
Atividades:
  • Planejamento e Organização de Projetos
    • Estruturar e documentar o plano do projeto (cronograma, escopo, orçamento, recursos e riscos).
    • Definir as entregas, marcos, indicadores e critérios de sucesso dos projetos.
    • Organizar os pacotes de trabalho.
    • Identificar stakeholders e elaborar o plano de comunicação.
  • Execução e Monitoramento
    • Acompanhar o progresso do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento de escopo, prazo, custo e qualidade.

    • Controlar orçamento, prazos e recursos, com ações corretivas em desvios identificados.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Mudanças
    • Identificar e avaliar riscos, criando planos de resposta e contingência.
    • Gerenciar solicitações de mudança de escopo (Change Request) com análise de impacto.
    • Manter registros atualizados sobre riscos, decisões e mudanças no projeto.
  • Relacionamento com Stakeholders
    • Alinhar expectativas com patrocinadores, clientes e áreas envolvidas.
    • Negociar prazos, prioridades e recursos com diferentes áreas e fornecedores.
    • Atuar como facilitador da comunicação entre todos os envolvidos no projeto.
  • Encerramento de Projetos
    • Garantir a entrega formal dos produtos ou resultados do projeto.
    • Conduzir reuniões de encerramento com stakeholders e equipe.
    • Documentar lições aprendidas e realizar a análise de desempenho do projeto.
    • Atualizar o portfólio de projetos com status final.
  • Apoio Estratégico e Governança
    • Participar de comitês de projetos e fóruns de governança.
    • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de processos de gerenciamento de projetos.
    • Apoiar áreas de negócios na construção de projetos estratégicos.
    • Atuar como mentor para gerentes de projeto júnior ou pleno.
Quem nós somos:
Nosso foco é pautado em agregar inteligência para a gestão da operação dos nossos clientes através do uso de tecnologia de ponta e por meio de ações que permitam construir relações estáveis e duradouras, com os nossos clientes, parceiros e colaboradores.
Na Ponce Tech, o cuidado é parte essencial da nossa cultura, e isso foi reconhecido pelo prêmio Unimed Fortaleza - Empresas que Cuidam . Fomos finalistas em 2023, alcançando o segundo lugar , e em 2024, conquistamos o primeiro lugar . Este é um reconhecimento às nossas iniciativas que priorizam a qualidade de vida, o bem-estar e a saúde dos nossos colaboradores, reforçando nosso compromisso em cuidar de quem faz parte da nossa jornada.

Procurement Project Manager

Position Summary
The Procurement Project Manager (PPM) is responsible to provide efficient and cost-effective value-added purchasing support. Within the Global Business Unit (GBU), the PPM is responsible for supporting procurement activity that are part of a bid, project or product delivery. Within the integrated team, the PPM represents and promotes the Procurement organization. In their role, the PPM provides the best procurement solution (competitiveness, quality, on-time delivery), fulfilling the customer needs and aligned with Thales procurement strategy led by the Global Category Managers (GCM). To this end, and to introduce supplier innovations to our solutions, the PPM plays a key role in the early stages of bids, projects and/or product/service delivery activities. This role is key to a major FAA project and setting up the supply chain and industrial solution with the Category Managers.
Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Develop and maintain the project procurement strategy using input from customer’s tender and prime contract documents, from the project management plan and project schedule from Project Management, project design documentation from Engineering, proposal documents from Marketing, and project financial data from Finance;
  • Challenge the acquisition needs and requirements and to promote design to cost analysis with the suppliers, during the definition phase of the solution, in order to increase the competitiveness of the solution;
  • Create work packages, including all required information to enable an RFQ/RFP (statement of work, delivery schedules, budget, etc.),
  • Assign work packages to relevant Category Manger / Category Buyer
  • Manage the development of the supply chain architecture to meet needs of the project with support from Regional and Global Category Management
  • Optimize supply chain costs early in the life cycle ensuring savings are achieved against budget;
  • Play a key role in defining and implementing strategies to meet U.S. Federal Procurement requirements including offsets, “Buy America” and Small Disadvantaged Business;
  • Work closely with stakeholders including Project Management, Engineering, Marketing and Finance to ensure the procurement strategy is communicated and well understood;
  • Support the flow of information with Project Management through regular reporting on the status of procurement activity - achievements, issues and goals;
  • Monitor project material costs and report deviations against the established project baseline;
  • Play a key role in Make or Buy analysis;
  • Contribute to Post Mortem Analysis (lessons learned) and implement required changes to support the project.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Procurement Management or ISM certifications;

  • Excellent organization skills;
  • Project management - planning, time management, problem solving, communication and teamwork;
  • Interpersonal skills - ability to excel working in cross-functional teams;
  • Ability to prioritize tasks while meeting deadlines in a high-pressure environment;

Join to apply for the Senior Web Application Engineer role at Street Diligence, Inc.

Street Diligence is a high-growth FinTech start-up with an innovative product offering and ambitious expansion plans. Our clients include leading financial institutions that use our platform to analyze and negotiate advantageous terms in legal and financial contracts. We break down key terms, identify what’s “market” and “off-market” and flags risks embedded in contract terms. Our platform also provides unique visuals, benchmarking and comparison to place negotiations and contracts in context. Founded in 2012, Street Diligence is headquartered in New York.
About The Role
Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.
Key Responsibilities
Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.
Technical Leadership:
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
Project Management:
  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.
Testing and Optimization:
  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
Collaboration and Communication:
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
What You'll Bring To The Table
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
    • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
    • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
    • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
    • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
    • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
    • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
We know that not everyone will meet all of the qualifications listed above. If your experience doesn't perfectly align, but you believe you'd be a strong fit for the team, we encourage you to apply. We’re eager to learn more about what you can offer!

title: GPM - Group Product Manager
description:
Job description

Ter um currículo compatível com a vaga é importante. Mas, existem outros fatores igualmente relevantes na hora de escolher um novo Hero para compor nosso time: a compatibilidade pela cultura e o protagonismo com a nossa missão!

Cultura Hero é sobre ser alguém com atitude, curiosidade, respeito ao próximo e muita disposição para aprender e fazer acontecer. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, pois acreditamos que times diversos são mais fortes e inovadores. Estamos em um momento único, investindo para crescer rápido e sermos líderes no nosso setor. Aqui você vai encontrar muitas oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento, em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico.

Quer fazer parte dessa construção e deixar o seu legado? Vem com a gente!

Sobre a Company Hero:

A Company Hero está revolucionando o mercado de trabalho independente no Brasil, sendo o aliado confiável dos profissionais PJ. Através de soluções práticas, empoderamos os PJs a crescer com liberdade e estabilidade. Nosso aplicativo pioneiro os orienta em cada etapa da jornada, transformando desafios em oportunidades.

Aqui, acreditamos no poder do trabalho independente e estamos prontos para apoiar cada herói a alcançar seu potencial máximo, transformando o medo da instabilidade em segurança!

Sobre nosso momento:

A Hero tem mais de 40 mil clientes com um faturamento sólido que cresce bem todos os meses.

Neste momento estamos ampliando a nossa proposta de valor, incluindo seguros e outros serviços que possam trazer tranquilidade para quem trabalha neste formato.

Por isso passamos recentemente por umarevolução de Produto e Tecnologia na empresa, migrando toda nossa operação para um aplicativo, o PJ Hero . Ao mesmo tempo que evoluímos nossa intra, infra e dados para suportar esta nova fase.

O animador de passar por esse processo é que estamos desenvolvendo as bases do zero e conectando tudo para que o produto promova os resultados esperados pelo negócio: tenha tração, uso recorrente e cross sell.

Sobre o Desafio:

Nesta posição, você será responsável por liderar a equipe de PMs e PDs com o objetivo de implementar a visão de produto da empresa, reportando diretamente ao Diretor.

Atualmente, temos uma squad por iniciativa de produto, além da iniciativa de IA, que está em formação. Cada uma dessas frentes está em um estágio diferente do ciclo de vida de produto.

Seu desafio será gerar coesão entre elas, acelerar o desenvolvimento dos PMs e PDs e alavancar os resultados das squads. Nesse contexto, você atuará de forma próxima aos times, entrando nos detalhes e influenciando diretamente o produto por meio dos rituais com o time. Além disso, terá um papel importante na construção e aplicação de ferramentas de gestão de carreira. O crescimento do seu time será um dos seus principais objetivos.

Além da atuação direta com seus liderados, você também terá um papel relevante nos projetos estratégicos em andamento, junto aos outros líderes de tecnologia e dados. Esse grupo é responsável pela definição estratégica de tecnologia da empresa, e você será a principal voz de produto nesse contexto.

Temos uma visão clara de negócio, alinhada à visão de produto. Mas, com sua experiência e aprendizados do dia a dia, você irá colaborar diretamente na definição e nos ajustes dessa estratégia e roadmap.

Apesar de a Hero já contar com 40.000 clientes e um sólido faturamento, mantemos a agilidade de uma startup em estágio inicial. Estamos em plena expansão — um cenário muito familiar para quem já foi fundador de uma startup ou esteve entre os primeiros colaboradores, mas com mais recursos

O produto é novo e temos que colocar o MVP no ar, do zero. Em paralelo, temos outros produtos ganhando tração e que precisam ser integrados à nossa estrutura — além de um que já gera milhares de vendas por mês e requer otimização da jornada.

Você vai se dar bem se curtir um ambiente dinâmico, aprender fazendo e tiver versatilidade para lidar com diferentes estágios de produto ao mesmo tempo. Mas vai se dar bem, principalmente, se já tiver vivido tudo isso antes.

Essa vaga é para quem já viveu esse cenário — e quer viver de novo, agora com mais estrutura, time e potencial para fazer a diferença.


Main responsibilities

  • Compreender a fundo o negócio da empresa e as suas focus metrics, contribuir para a formulação de estratégias dos produto junto com a equipe;
  • Compreender profundamente o usuário e seus desafios da experiência, no produto e fora dele. Atuar na busca de soluções;
  • Desenvolvimento de pessoas deve ser um dos seus temas favoritos. Aprender, implementar e aprimorar ferramentas de desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecer detalhadamente o perfil e competências dos liderados. Planejar e trabalhar em conjunto para seu crescimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Ter rituais para analisar métricas e definir plano de ação com as equipes;
  • Manter a comunicação e o alinhamento com as lideranças das outras áreas, gerando combinado e facilitando o trabalho da equipe;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das iniciativas da equipe de perto, tendo o roadmap como referência. Retirar impedimentos e fazer negociações sempre quando necessário;
  • Ser um embaixador e referência em gestão de produtos;
  • Promover a cultura de produtos na empresa e na equipe, incorporando boas práticas, talks, frameworks e metodologias que orientem a criação de produtos de valor;
  • Acompanhar de perto artigos, concorrentes e benchmarks, para enriquecer as discussões e trazer novas oportunidades de gerar crescimento e/ou melhorar a experiência dos clientes;
  • Propor e facilitar discussões entre stakeholders para avançar na definição e de estratégias ou decisões importantes para a o negócio;
  • Trabalhar com o Diretor nos follow ups e fora deles para colaborar em iniciativas e manter todos atualizados.

Requirements and skills

  • Ter sido fundador de uma startup ou ter estado entre os primeiros funcionários;
  • Atuado pelo menos 2 ano em startup, não importa o resultado dela;
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em gerenciamento de produtos com histórico de ter feito lançamentos e busca de PMF;
  • Ampla vivência na gestão e monitoramento de cadeias de valor, com exemplos concretos de resultados alcançados nas empresas em que trabalhou;
  • Ter vivências que comprovem forte capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Ter vivência e conhecimento técnico suficiente para conduzir uma squad especialista, como dados e meios de pagamento;
  • Excelente capacidade analíticas orientada a problema, com habilidade de elaborar hipóteses e testes lógicos para elas;
  • Escuta ativa e habilidade de capturar a necessidade do cliente;
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e falada, com capacidade de síntese e simplificação para adapta-la de acordo com a situação;
  • Adorar trabalhar em equipe, em ambientes não hierárquicos;
  • Imprescindível disponibilidade para trabalhar no Híbrido 2x/semana em São Paulo

Você vai se dar bem se:

  • Gostar de estar em um ambiente acelerado;
  • Gostar de trabalhar em equipe e fazer parte de um time que trabalha sério mas de forma leve e divertida;
  • For muito organizado e orientado ao resultado/impacto;
  • Sempre investir em comunicar bem, usando recursos visuais sempre que for facilitar a compreensão - fazer o complexo se tornar simples;
  • Tiver poder de síntese e pensamento lógico;
  • Estiver buscando um desafio para construir um case;
  • Gostar de entender tecnicamente como as soluções funcionam.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ACCOUNTING & FINANCE

What We Do

Our Finance and Accounting teams build the financial infrastructure to scale our growing company. We combine analytical and strategic thinking to develop a sound financial future for our global brand. We work closely with teams across the company, international subsidiaries, as well as with external partners to ensure a world-class finance organization. Our team contains experts from fields like tax, treasury, purchasing, FP&A, and more.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a General Ledger Accountant to join our growing Brazil Finance team. This role is to be based in Brazil. You will work alongside existing members of the Brazil Finance team and partner with them and others within Epic to provide day-to-day accounting and transitional assistance, deliver high-quality financial reporting, and support ad hoc finance-related projects for Epic Brazil. This will enable us to provide complete and accurate financial reporting to the US and the United Kingdom. The role will take responsibility for building best in class reporting and control structures to ensure that Epic’s financial and operational performance is optimized, scalable and clearly communicated on a timely and accurate basis.

In this role, you will

  • Be responsible for the management of the financial accounting, including accrual and provision calculations and postings, reconciliations and financial closing activities (monthly and yearly)
  • Financial accounting Reporting for Epic UK and US
  • Management of the annual statutory audit
  • Collaborate regarding system and process enhancements
  • Fixed asset accounting and administration (including depreciation, asset tracking, and leases)
  • Tax declarations, statistical report preparation and submissions
  • Be the point of contact for any accounting or transactional queries from the Business

What we're looking for

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, any other languages are appreciated
  • 3-5 years recent and relevant work experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting. With Active CRC
  • Strong knowledge of General Ledger accounting processes and procedures, ERP systems (Senior Sistemas and Workday are preferable) and MS Excel - Google Sheets is a plus
  • Experience dealing with External Auditor requests
  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills
  • Ability to multitask and meet deadlines in a timely manner
  • Attention to detail, organization and experience in a fast-paced environment

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

title: Head of Marketing & Communications, Brazil
description:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Head of Marketing & Communications, Brazil to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make your mark in Marketing & Communications

How you will create an impact

Reporting to the Head Marketing and Communications, Latin America and Caribbean, and to the GM for Brazil, this role has accountability of marketing and communications strategy, internal communications, content marketing, events, media relations and sales enablement in support of AIG Brazil.

The role will be responsible for establishing processes, best practices, and strategic business marketing and communications plans in support of AIG Brazil – including distribution engagement programs targeted to clients, brokers and partners; our events program, product/solutions marketing, differentiated knowledge leadership, attributable content marketing, and alignment with distribution to deliver AIG’s full capabilities to the market. This role is also responsible for developing and implementing strategic communications plans, encompassing external, internal and leadership communications, media relations and knowledge leadership to AIG’s stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead an integrated marketing and communications team, creating alignment and consistency in Marketing & Communications strategy and messaging, strengthening capabilities, and driving a culture of high performance to deliver sustainable, high-quality services.
  • Mentor and develop team members about core marketing and communications disciplines including audience targeting and segmentation, customer value propositions, business development, pipeline management, media relations, event management, industry events, campaign planning, and KPI/ROI reporting;
  • Provide guidance and oversight of marketing and communications plans and budgets aligned with AIG Brazil business priorities;
  • Develop best practices for demand-driven event marketing, knowledge leadership, content marketing and social media campaigns that facilitate sales growth;
  • Closely partner with Brazil business and functional leaders to promote and sustain a consistent AIG brand identity across businesses;
  • Manage Brazil business and industry media relations, including news releases and interviews, speaking opportunities, and issues and crisis management communications in coordination with AIG corporate teams;
  • Oversight and governance of external vendor engagement

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Significant experience in marketing and communications strategy development, execution and team leadership
  • Thorough knowledge of marketing and communications principles, product/service management, sales enablement and business development
  • Demonstrated ability to manage media relations, crisis management and corporate social responsibility efforts
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing communications and PR, content production, technology platforms and sponsorship/event management
  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling and in developing compelling and segmented narratives for key internal and external stakeholder groups
  • Ability to produce high-quality, high-volume deliverables in a dynamic environment, effectively aligning Country Marketing & Communications strategies and activities
  • Significant prior experience managing complex projects across geographies, businesses, products and segments;
  • Demonstrated ability to cultivate meaningful working relationships as a trusted and influential advisor to senior executives, and to deliver within a global matrixed environment;
  • Proven ability to lead and develop teams, driving high levels of performance and build a pipeline of talent within the function;
  • Experience within the Insurance, broader Financial Services or regulated sectors preferred;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, preferably also Spanish

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

title: Pessoa Analista de Compras Sênior
description:
Profissional responsável por gerenciar e conduzir processos estratégicos e operacionais de compras, assegurando a otimização de custos, qualidade dos produtos e serviços adquiridos e a eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos. Atua estrategicamente na negociação, homologação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, buscando inovação, mitigação de riscos e excelência operacional.

Atuação está diretamente ligada ao cumprimento de normas, políticas internas e compliance, garantindo que as aquisições sejam feitas de forma sustentável e alinhada aos objetivos da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar processos de compras, incluindo a elaboração de RFI (Request for Information), RFQ (Request for Quotation) e RFP (Request for Proposal) para garantir competitividade e transparência.
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de compras, desde a identificação da necessidade até a entrega e pagamento, garantindo que os processos sigam as diretrizes da empresa.
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos, assegurando qualidade, confiabilidade e competitividade.
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e auditorias a fornecedores, garantindo conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos.
  • Negociar cláusulas contratuais e elaborar contratos comerciais, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, custos e qualidade dos produtos e serviços.
  • Implementar práticas de Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores (SRM), garantindo relacionamento saudável e de longo prazo com fornecedores.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, oscilações de preços e riscos econômicos (como variação cambial, custo de matérias-primas e inflação).
  • Implementar estratégias para redução de custos e maximização de eficiência operacional, aplicando conceitos como TCO (Custo total por propriedade) e should cost analysis (Custo x Benefício).
  • Assegurar a conformidade dos processos de compras com as normas fiscais, tributárias e auditorias aplicáveis.
  • Utilizar dashboards e ferramentas analíticas (Power BI, Excel avançado, Tableau) para suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Aplicar metodologias Lean e Six Sigma para redução de desperdícios e melhoria contínua dos processos de suprimentos.
  • Monitorar os níveis de estoque e consumo, propondo estratégias de compras just-in-time (JIT) para redução de custos e otimização de armazenagem.
  • Planejar e gerenciar operações de importação e desembaraço aduaneiro, garantindo conformidade regulatória e eficiência no tempo de entrega.
  • Analisar o impacto logístico das aquisições, incluindo fretes, armazenagem e modais de transporte.
  • Participar ativamente do planejamento orçamentário da área de compras, garantindo alinhamento financeiro e previsibilidade.
  • Promover inovação na cadeia de suprimentos, buscando novas tecnologias e fornecedores que agreguem valor ao negócio.
  • Demais atividades inerentes da função.

Buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte do nosso banco de talentos para futuras oportunidades na adidas. Venha fazer parte você também!

Queremos em nosso time pessoas apaixonadas e diversas, que nos ajudem a transformar o impossível em possível todos os dias, atingindo nossos objetivos, inovando e dominando o jogo constantemente.

Descrição da empresa

Tudo o que fazemos está enraizado no esporte. O esporte desempenha um papel cada vez mais importante na vida das pessoas, dentro e fora do jogo. É fundamental para nossa cultura, sociedade, saúde e felicidade.

Join to apply for the Junior Consultant role at Red Hat

Job Summary

What is a Junior Consultant at Red Hat?
As part of the customer delivery team, a Junior Consultant at Red Hat is a technical person who supports the on-site delivery, implementation and adoption of Red Hat technology. These projects span various industries as we partner with customers to build enterprise IT solutions based on Red Hat platforms that are the trusted, consistent, and comprehensive foundation for any enterprise.

Job Summary
You may be thinking -- What is a Junior Consultant at Red Hat?
As part of the customer delivery team, a Junior Consultant at Red Hat is a technical person who supports the on-site delivery, implementation and adoption of Red Hat technology. These projects span various industries as we partner with customers to build enterprise IT solutions based on Red Hat platforms that are the trusted, consistent, and comprehensive foundation for any enterprise.
In other words, a Junior Consultant at Red Hat can be you…
So, are you ready to launch your technical career with Red Hat? If so, we are looking for passionate individuals early in their technical career to help us unlock the world’s potential.
What You Will Do
During your first year as a Junior Consultant, you will engage in a cohort-based program. Through this experience, you will:

  • Learn all about Red Hat and how we support our customers to address their technical developmental and strategic business challenges with our portfolio and services
  • Build a strong support network of your Peers, Manager, Mentor and other Red Hatters within and outside of your customer projects
  • Develop technical skills in the Red Hat portfolio that span Cloud, Automation and AI solutions by completing training programs and attaining industry-recognized certifications
  • Apply your technical skills as you engage in meaningful customer projects, experiences and job shadowing opportunities
  • Enhance your professional capabilities through real-world experiences working directly with customers and participating in skill development opportunities
  • Focus on your personal and professional development as you grow your career at Red Hat
What You Will Bring
  • Passion and curiosity for open source technology and desire to build a career within the Tech industry
  • Strong technical skills in computer science, IT, AI, or related fields gained through university programs, upskilling bootcamps, certificate programs, military experience, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience applying technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills in an Enterprise IT-related project. Direct experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, and related technologies is preferred.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites for project work and to local Red Hat offices to engage other Red Hat associates
  • Effective communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with internal teams and external customers
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken Portuguese
About Red Hat
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. title: FX Art Lead Porto Alegre (Brazil) Epic Games Technical Art Senior (5+ years)
description:
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for an experienced FX Art Lead to join our team working on Fortnite. A successful candidate should have a strong sense of dramatic effects and an understanding of how to recreate them in a real time particle editor. They will be first and foremost a team player, while also having the ability to be self-motivated and work autonomously. If you have a strong sense of weight, timing, motion, and you demonstrate technical aptitude with Materials and Logic, we are ready for you to bring those abilities to execute outstanding FX in our games.

In this role, you will

Create all art needed for the visual effects, including FX concept, proto and final FX, with blueprint and Niagara logic, models, textures, materials, camera effects, animations and particles

Execute on a range of visual effects styles from realistic to stylized

Lead a growing team of effects artists, mentor and coach artists you work with

Collaborate with other discipline teams to produce cohesive game experience

Partner with external vendors, onboard and support production of FX outside of Epic Games

Drive the style and feel of Fortnite’s FX

Work closely with the production on the schedule to deliver the FX in a timely manner

What we’re looking for

Must have a strong reel/portfolio showing executed Real-Time FX work

Critical eye for the timing, animation, and motion of real-world objects and visual FX with an ability to bring dramatic FX to life with a flair

Good instincts for realistic and stylized FX

Ability to create all art needed for the FX

Experience in VFX (games or film) is a must. Shipped AAA game titles is a plus

Familiarity with UE5 or other real-time engine art pipelines is a big plus

If you have a portfolio/reel/website you'd like to share, please hyperlink it to your resume, or submit it as an attachment with your application. (OPTIONAL - art roles only)

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees and dependents and offer coverage for supplemental medical, dental, vision, critical illness, telemedicine, Life and AD&D, long term disability insurance as well as weekly indemnity (short term disability) and a retirement savings plan with a competitive employer match. In addition to the EAP (employee assistance program), we also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Seu bem-estar importa. Junte-se a uma empresa que se importa também.

Wellhub (antes, Gympass*) é uma plataforma de bem-estar corporativo que conecta os colaboradores aos melhores parceiros para exercício físico, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e rotina de sono, tudo incluso em uma assinatura que custa menos do que a individual de cada parceiro. Fundada em 2012 e sediada em Nova York, nossa empresa tem uma equipe crescente em 11 países. No Wellhub, você tem a oportunidade de construir a sua carreira em uma empresa de tecnologia de alto crescimento, que coloca o bem-estar como base da sua cultura e, além disso, contribui para fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.

*Grande novidade: Gympass agora é Wellhub!

Estamos felizes em anunciar nossa mudança de marca para Wellhub, um marco significativo na nossa jornada. Essa transformação reflete nossa evolução de “passe para academias” para uma solução ampla de bem-estar para colaboradores. Com nossa identidade atualizada, estamos prontos para embarcar em um capítulo novo e empolgante de crescimento e expansão. Estamos elevando nossa oferta, incluindo uma experiência completamente nova em nosso app e expansão da rede de nossos parceiros de bem-estar. Veja mais sobre isso aqui.

Estamos contratando uma pessoa Senior Manager de Marketing Operations para o nosso time de Marketing B2B no Brasil !

Essa pessoa vai liderar, otimizar e escalar o motor que impulsiona nossa equipe global de marketing B2B. Sendo responsável pelos processos, tecnologia e dados que permitem à equipe de marketing atingir seus objetivos com eficiência. Esta posição exige um profundo entendimento da estratégia de funil de vendas e marketing B2B e do cenário de martech.

Esta posição impacta diretamente a capacidade da equipe de marketing B2B de alcançar suas metas de forma eficiente, impulsionando o crescimento mensurável do negócio e garantindo a excelência em marketing.

  • Construção e Otimização do Motor de Marketing: Possuir a visão para a função de operações de marketing B2B, mantendo os sistemas e processos que permitem à equipe de marketing escalar efetivamente.
  • Tecnologia e Estratégia: Liderar o planejamento estratégico, gestão e otimização do roadmap de tecnologia de marketing, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio. Supervisionar todo o stack de martech, desde a seleção de fornecedores e aquisição até a implementação, integração e adoção pelo usuário.
  • Processos e Automação: Projetar, gerenciar e otimizar processos de marketing essenciais, incluindo gestão de leads (pontuação, roteamento, nutrição), fluxos de trabalho de execução de campanhas e governança de dados. Identificar e implementar oportunidades de automação para melhorar a eficiência e eficácia.
  • IA e Inovação: Atuar como o principal evangelista de IA em marketing; identificar, avaliar e implementar ferramentas e estratégias baseadas em IA para impulsionar a personalização, eficiência operacional e análises mais aprofundadas.
  • Dados e Análise: Estabelecer e aplicar políticas de governança de dados para garantir a qualidade, higiene e conformidade dos dados nos sistemas de marketing. Em parceria com a equipe de Analytics, desenvolver e manter uma estrutura robusta de análise de marketing, incluindo dashboards e relatórios para rastrear KPIs como funis de lead-to-receita, atribuição de campanha e saúde do banco de dados.
  • Habilitação da Equipe: Atuar como o principal especialista em tecnologia e processos de marketing, treinando e suportando a equipe de marketing em ferramentas novas e existentes, promovendo as melhores práticas para impulsionar a adoção e maximizar o valor dos investimentos em tecnologia.
  • Liderança Interfuncional: Colaborar com as equipes de marketing, vendas, produto e engenharia para definir requisitos para novas capacidades e integrações de marketing. Atuar como o principal ponto de contato para problemas de tecnologia de marketing, garantindo resolução rápida e comunicação clara aos stakeholders.
  • Medição de Desempenho: Analisar o desempenho de marketing e as métricas operacionais para identificar tendências, gargalos e áreas de melhoria. Comunicar insights e resultados a stakeholders em todos os níveis, incluindo o Diretor Sênior de Martech e, por vezes, VPs de Marketing, Vendas e Engenharia.
  • Viva a missão: inspire e empodere Wellhubbers ao priorizar seu próprio bem-estar e de seus colegas. Faça parte de um ambiente de apoio, onde todas as pessoas se sentem à vontade para cuidar de si mesmas, tirar folgas e encontrar um equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Bacharelado em Marketing, Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou área correlata.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos:
    • Expertise em Proficiência em Plataformas de Automação de Marketing (ex: Hubspot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo).
    • Conhecimento de conceitos técnicos como modelagem de dados, pipelines e workflows de sistemas.
    • Experiência prática com Plataformas de Dados do Cliente (CDP - ex: Segment, Tealium, AEP, Salesforce Data Cloud, mParticle).
    • Familiaridade com Ferramentas de Visualização de Dados (ex: Tableau, Power BI).
    • Familiaridade com Ferramentas de Análise Web e de Produto (ex: Amplitude, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics).
    • Experiência na Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores e Orçamentos de Tecnologia.
    • Conhecimento em regulamentações de privacidade de dados (ex: GDPR, CCPA).
    • Proficiência em Ferramentas de Gerenciamento de Projetos (ex: Asana)
  • Experiência:
    • Experiência em operações de marketing, martech ou áreas relacionadas, com histórico comprovado na construção e escalonamento de uma função de operações de marketing.
    • Experiência prévia em produtos B2B, preferencialmente em grandes empresas de software.
    • Experiência com gestão de pessoas, gerenciando gerentes/especialistas seniores.
  • Idiomas: Fluência em Inglês é mandatório.

Férias após 6 meses e 3 dias de folga por ano + 1 dia de folga para cada ano de mandato (até 5 dias adicionais) + dia de folga extra no seu aniversário.

CULTURA: Entre em uma atmosfera animada e de apoio constante, com pessoas de diversos cantos do mundo. Você vai construir parcerias com colegas de diversos países e integrar o sucesso de uma empresa de tecnologia de alto crescimento, que traz soluções revolucionárias no seu segmento. Aqui, a sua autonomia vai se transformar em um impacto duradouro no negócio e no mundo. Nossa cultura baseada em confiança, flexibilidade e integridade torna tudo isso possível todos os dias. Saiba mais sobre a nossa cultura em nossa página de carreiras .

O Wellhub é um empregador comprometido com a promoção de oportunidades iguais. Senior Technical Product Manager - Brazil

We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

Why Topsort? Why now?

Topsort is changing the way Retail Media works. By joining our scaling team, you'll feel your impact from day 1. The processes and messaging you build today will be a critical part of our foundation as we accelerate toward 200 Topsorters worldwide, and your innovations will leave a lasting mark on the industry, as a whole. Retail Media is on the verge of a new era, and Topsort is gathering the ecosystem together to shape a brighter future. Joining us now, you'll work directly alongside our co-founders and founding members to bring on Retail Media 3.0. If you're looking to define your career as something greater than yourself, come scale with us.

What it’s like to work at Topsort

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. It’s a sports team that’s hyper focused on winning, collaborative internally, and competitive externally - never the other way around. We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

What is this role like? We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior Technical Product Manager with strong product instincts and deep technical expertise. In this role, you’ll lead complex initiatives end-to-end—working closely with engineering and business teams to turn technical possibilities into real product value. You’ll thrive in fast-paced environments and play a key role in shaping the future of our platform.

  • End-to-End Product Ownership – Oversee the entire product lifecycle, from vision and strategy to execution and adoption.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with engineering, design, and business teams to define product and technical requirements that align with both technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Sprint & Development Alignment – Actively participate in sprint planning and review meetings to ensure smooth execution and alignment with product objectives.
  • Technical Decision-Making – Evaluate and select the best solutions by balancing trade-offs, feasibility, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Performance Monitoring & Documentation – Continuously track product performance, maintain clear technical documentation, and ensure operational readiness.

What (we think) you need to be successful - we’re open to not checking all the boxes and be proven wrong by outlier candidates as well!

  • Experience as a Software Developer or strong programming experience necessary.
  • Experience in related roles in a B2B SaaS environment; experience with Integrations and Partnerships is a huge plus.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with executive-level stakeholders and manage Enterprise customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain business partnerships to enhance product offerings and drive business growth.
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related field; MBA is highly desired.
  • Availability to work onsite 4 days per week at our Sao Paulo office.

About Topsort

Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic that’s had rapid growth since out of a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a hardworking team of talented individuals. Since our founding in 2021, we’ve gained customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps in 40+ countries and quickly approaching the #1 position in the industry.

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact, being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s do the unimaginable - let’s make ads clean and cool again, with AI and modern technology.

What We Value

At Topsort, we seek professionals who embody the following qualities to drive our mission forward:

  • Deep dive into details: Professionals who are not content with superficial answers and dive deeply into the details to uncover root causes and optimal solutions.
  • Team first: A low need for individual recognition, always prioritizing collective results over personal credit.
  • You thrive with ambiguity: Exceptional ability to tackle open-ended problems in unstructured environments, turning chaos into structured innovation.
  • Adaptability: Willingness to learn, mentor, lead, and follow as the situation demands, fostering growth at all levels.
  • Urgency : A disproportionate sense of urgency in execution, while keeping scalability and the creation of replicable processes in mind to ensure long-term success.
  • Curiosity: Genuinely curious individuals who can quickly learn difficult concepts and apply them effectively.

Do you sound like the right fit? Let's dive right in!
